defs.d: A shift (scheduled work period) that takes place early in the day.
At a time in advance of the usual or expected event.
defs.ex: at eleven, we went for an early lunch;  she began reading at an early age;  his mother suffered an early death

defs.d: Arriving a time before expected; sooner than on time.
defs.ex: The early guests sipped their punch and avoided each other's eyes.

defs.d: At a time before expected; sooner than usual.
defs.ex: We finished the project an hour sooner than scheduled, so we left early.

defs.d: Soon; in good time; seasonably.
A fanciful or whimsical person.
Existing in or constructed from fantasy; of or relating to fantasy; fanciful.
defs.ex: He told fantastic stories of dragons and goblins.

defs.d: Not believable; implausible; seemingly only possible in fantasy.
defs.ex: She entered the lab and stood gaping for a good ten minutes at the fantastic machinery at work all around her.

defs.d: New information of interest.
defs.ex: Is there any news about the storm?

defs.d: Information about current events disseminated via media.
defs.ex: Did you hear/read/see the latest news?

defs.d: To report; to make known.
The part of something that faces out; the outer surface.
defs.ex: He's repainting the outside of his house.

defs.d: The external appearance of someone or something.
defs.ex: Her outside was stern, but inside was a heart of gold.

defs.d: Of or pertaining to the outer surface, limit or boundary.
defs.ex: The outside surface looks good.

defs.d: Of, pertaining to or originating from beyond the outer surface, limit or boundary.
To or in the outdoors or outside; to or in an area that is beyond the scope, limits or borders of a given place.
defs.ex: I am going outside.

defs.d: Outdoors.
defs.ex: I slept outside last night.

defs.d: Opportunity or scope (to do something).
Space for something, or to carry out an activity.
To reside, especially as a boarder or tenant.
defs.ex: Doctor Watson roomed with Sherlock Holmes at Baker Street.

defs.d: To assign to a room; to allocate a room to.
To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).
(object pronoun) The people spoken, or written to, as an object.
defs.ex: Both of you should get ready now.

defs.d: (reflexive pronoun) (To) yourselves, (to) yourself.
To bring into a group, class, set, or total as a (new) part or member.
defs.ex: I will purchase the vacation package if you will include car rental.

defs.d: To contain, as parts of a whole; to comprehend.
defs.ex: Does this volume of Shakespeare include his sonnets?

defs.d: Such as, among which; introducing one or more parts of the group or topic just mentioned.
defs.ex: All you have to do is to fill in the details, including your name and address and the amount you wish to give.

defs.d: In a fortunate manner.
It is (or was, etc) fortunate that.
defs.ex: Fortunately, Sam's pet hamster was not dead.

defs.d: One who instructs; a teacher.
A villain or bad guy; the one responsible for evil or aggressive acts.
defs.ex: With his wrinkled, uneven face, the actor always seemed to play the heavy in films.

defs.d: A doorman, bouncer or bodyguard.
defs.ex: A fight started outside the bar but the heavies came out and stopped it.

defs.d: (often with "up") To make heavier.
To sadden.
(of a physical object) Having great weight.
(of a topic) Serious, somber.
An abstract representational system used in the study of numbers, shapes, structure, change and the relationships between these concepts.
A person's ability to count, calculate, and use different systems of mathematics at differing levels.
defs.ex: My mathematics is always improving.

defs.d: In a sad manner; sorrowfully.
defs.ex: “Only when we climb up can we see it,” he said sadly.

defs.d: Unfortunately, sad to say.
defs.ex: If you think you’re getting out of this place alive, you are sadly mistaken, my friend.

defs.d: (in a person) The state of being calm; peacefulness; absence of worry, anger, fear or other strong negative emotion.
(in a place or situation) The state of being calm; absence of noise and disturbance.
To make calm.
defs.ex: to calm a crying baby

defs.d: To become calm.
(of a person) Peaceful, quiet, especially free from anger and anxiety.
(of a place or situation) Free of noise and disturbance.
The end, finish, close or last part of something.
The outcome or result of a process or act.
Something that is rejected.
An unpopular person.
To refuse to accept.
defs.ex: She even rejected my improved offer.

defs.d: To block a shot, especially if it sends the ball off the court.
To tell in a descriptive way.
defs.ex: Please relate the circumstances of your journey here today.

defs.d: To bring into a relation, association, or connection (between one thing and another).
Something secret or unexplainable; an unknown.
defs.ex: The truth behind the events remains a mystery.

defs.d: Someone or something with an obscure or puzzling nature.
defs.ex: That man is a mystery.

defs.d: An existing criminal record (short for "previous convictions")
defs.ex: It turned out the shoplifter had a lot of previous.

defs.d: A track record of similar behaviour.
Prior; occurring before something else, either in time or order.
defs.ex: He is no better than the previous Prime Minister.

defs.d: Premature; acting or occurring too soon.
In a proper manner, appropriately, suitably; correctly, justifiably
Entirely; extremely; thoroughly.
defs.ex: I was properly tired after that party.

defs.d: Any great, strong, powerful emotion, especially romantic love or extreme hate.
defs.ex: We share a passion for books.

defs.d: Fervor, determination.
To suffer pain or sorrow; to experience a passion; to be extremely agitated.
To give a passionate character to.
An inclination in a particular direction.
defs.ex: the trend of a coastline

defs.d: A tendency.
defs.ex: There is a trend, these days, for people in films not to smoke.

defs.d: To have a particular direction; to run; to stretch; to tend.
defs.ex: The shore of the sea trends to the southwest.

defs.d: To cause to turn; to bend.
To go; walk; proceed.
To get hold of; to gain possession of, to procure; to acquire, in any way.
To secure (that) a specific objective or state of affairs be reached.
A Christian religious song, especially one in an African-American style, or a similar non-religious song.
Any spiritual function, office, or affair.
defs.ex: He assigns supremacy to the pope in spirituals, and to the emperor in temporals. — Lowell.

defs.d: Of or pertaining to the spirit or the soul.
defs.ex: Respect towards ancestors is an essential part of Thai spiritual practice.

defs.d: Of or pertaining to God or a place of worship; sacred.
